notes.title: Demo 2.1 Update
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone! 

We just released a new demo update!

Bug fixes:
> 1) Card duplication - The upgraded card can now be properly duplicated (used to duplicate the basic card)
> 2) Continue game - The game now properly load the correct chapter when you press Continue in the Main Menu. (used to load into chapter 1 with items and deck acquired in chapter 2)
> 3) Fixed the problem with inconsistent fonts due to outdated localization files. 

Updates:
> 1) Added miscellaneous sound effects
> 2) Status effects:
> - Extra Block now applies only through cards (doesn't stack with other block sources like items and potions)
> - Poison now deals damage at the start of yours or enemies turn (used to deal damage after the turn)
> 3) Added spawn animations for the minions in the boss battles
> 4) Blacksmith: The price of the shop's banner abilities now increases by 50 coins for each use

Card updates:
> 1) Xin Card: Dagger Guard - Upgraded card (route Y) now gives you 2x block (used to give you 1x block)
> 2) Xin Card: Critical Whip - Upgraded card (route Y) now requires dice from 2-4 range (used to be the same as route X upgrade)

Please remember to leave us your feedback with this form: [url="https://forms.gle/HgHvX1Mib7rb6mL68"]https://forms.gle/HgHvX1Mib7rb6mL68[/url][/p]
